verdict.rationale: dltHub docs mention monitoring pipeline health/logs/failures (dlt-docs-15) and scheduling/backfill orchestration (dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-70), which could support cadence tracking, but there is no explicit feature for computing table freshness metrics or alerting when a pipeline misses its expected cadence/SLA. Missing for 10: explicit freshness/staleness metric per destination table, documented SLA-based alerting or notification mechanism, and independent evidence of this working in practice.
